name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2025-05-23, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
